description: Which of MLB, WNBA, PGA, ATP, and NFL have a checkable slate right now - at least one simulated game that has not started. Pass `sport` for one; omit it for all. Free, spends no check. It is not required before `check_bet`, which reports a missing slate itself at no cost. Call it to answer "what can be checked today", or after a `no_slate` or `ungraded` result, which mean the game is not on the simulated slate rather than that the bet was worded wrong.

sport.description: One of: MLB, WNBA, PGA, ATP, NFL. Omit to get every live sport.

name: get_slate
title: Today's slate
